dispatchContext.pmReadContext: This packet covers task 'kie-ref-unique-names' in the bb-plugin-image-studio repository. The objective is to ensure that concurrent kie generation jobs upload reference images under unique filenames so they do not collide or swap references. In src/providers.ts, kieUploadReference currently hardcodes fileName as `ref-${index}.png` within uploadPath 'image-studio'. When multiple kieGenerate calls run concurrently, each job uploads its references using identical index-based names (e.g., ref-0.png, ref-1.png) to https://kieai.redpandaai.co/api/file-base64-upload or file-url-upload, creating race conditions and reference overwrites on the hosting server. Invariants require that uploaded file names retain the '.png' extension, retry/error handling in kieUploadReference remain unchanged, and fal generation/upload paths remain untouched. Acceptance requires adding a passing test in tests/providers.test.ts named 'concurrent kie jobs upload references under unique names' verifying four distinct .png filenames across two concurrent jobs, and bumping package.json to version 0.10.4.
